newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to buy three cos for $31 mln.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to buy three cos for $31 mln.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Monday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the fixed assets of Big A Well Service Co, Sunco Trucking Co and Justis Supply Co from Coleman Oil & Gas Co for about $31 million.
The purchase price consists of $28 million in cash and 125,000 shares of Key Energy common stock.

The purchased assets of the three companies, which are based in Farmington, New Mexico, include 29 well service/workover rigs, four shallow drilling rigs, 75 fluid hauling and other trucks, 121 frac and other tanks, and a saltwater disposal well.

The assets also include 60 blowout preventers, 27 swivels, 47 pumps, drill pipe, two pipe storage yards, a KCl plant, bulk cement handling equipment (for plugging and abandonment operations) and a machine shop/supply store serving oilfield, industrial and mining customers.
